description: Enzyme Commission (EC) classifications from the IUBMB Enzyme Nomenclature, spanning class, subclass, sub-subclass, and full four-part enzyme entries. Transferred and deleted entries remain represented with an obsolete flag.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: EC number in numeric-prefix form: class 1, subclass 1.1, sub-subclass 1.1.1, or full entry 1.1.1.1; without a CURIE prefix or dash padding.

common_properties.name: class
common_properties.description: Class coordinate in the EC hierarchy, present at all levels.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the EC classification.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the EC record was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: All four EC hierarchy levels, including transferred and deleted enzyme entries. Intermediate classifications are limited to headings present in ExplorEnz; some full enzyme entries therefore lack an immediate parent classification. Literature references are not included.
source_contributions.description: ExplorEnz supplies the IUBMB enzyme classification, enzyme names, reactions, descriptive text, CAS registry numbers, and hierarchy coordinates. Leaf-only properties are absent on intermediate classifications; names and reactions may also be absent on obsolete entries.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Accepted enzyme name for a full enzyme entry, or classification heading for an intermediate level.

properties.name: sys_name
properties.description: Systematic enzyme name; available only on full enzyme entries.

properties.name: synonyms
properties.description: Other names for the enzyme; available only on full enzyme entries.

properties.name: reaction
properties.description: Reactions catalyzed by the enzyme; available only on full enzyme entries.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Descriptive comments for a full enzyme entry, or a note about an intermediate classification.

properties.name: cas_num
properties.description: CAS registry numbers associated with the enzyme; available only on full enzyme entries.

properties.name: glossary
properties.description: Glossary text associated with a full enzyme entry.

properties.name: subclass
properties.description: Subclass coordinate in the EC hierarchy; present at subclass, sub-subclass, and full-entry levels.

properties.name: subsubclass
properties.description: Sub-subclass coordinate in the EC hierarchy; present at sub-subclass and full-entry levels.

properties.name: serial
properties.description: Serial coordinate of a full four-part EC entry; absent on intermediate classifications.

properties.name: obsolete
properties.description: True for transferred or deleted enzyme entries. Absent on active entries; does not distinguish transferred from deleted.
